def evolved_p94(x, N, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # x[i,j] = i*j + (i-j)^2
    idx = torch.arange(N, device=x.device).float()
    ii = idx.view(N, 1)
    jj = idx.view(1, N)
    d = ii - jj
    out = ii * jj + d * d
    return out.to(x.dtype)
